title: Law to excuse taxis stopping to help disabled riders
summary: This bill would create a legal defense to parking tickets for TLC-licensed drivers who stop or stand briefly to assist a passenger with impaired mobility. The defense would not apply if the driver blocks a fire hydrant, emergency vehicle, bus or bike lane, median, intersection or crosswalk, or stops for more than 10 minutes. The law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
